description:
rnews_main.rs:36–75: parse_args() is a 40-line manual loop over std::env::args() to handle exactly two flags (--config, --check). The happy path is buried in match arms, and adding a new flag requires more boilerplate. stoa-ctl already depends on clap 4 with derive, so clap is already a proven pattern in this repo.

Suggested approach: replace parse_args() with a #[derive(Parser)] struct:

    #[derive(clap::Parser)]
    struct Args {
        #[arg(long)]
        config: PathBuf,
        #[arg(long)]
        check: bool,
    }

This shrinks ~40 lines to ~8, generates --help automatically, and makes the CLI contract visible at a glance. Add clap = { version = "4", features = ["derive"] } to crates/transit/Cargo.toml.
title: hand-rolled arg parser obscures CLI contract
